title: DNA Replication and Repair
objectives: Identify key enzymes in DNA synthesis
Relate replication errors to genetic disorders

replication_machinery.title: Replication Complex
replication_machinery.content:
• Helicase: Unwinds DNA (DnaB in E. coli)
  • Primase: Synthesizes RNA primers
  • DNA Polymerase III: Main replicase (5'→3' synthesis)
  • Ligase: Joins Okazaki fragments

repair_pathways.title: Repair Systems
repair_pathways.content:
Base Excision Repair (BER)
• Fixes single-base damage
• Key enzyme: DNA glycosylase
• Example: Uracil excision
Nucleotide Excision Repair (NER)
• Repairs bulky lesions
• Key in xeroderma pigmentosum
• Removes thymine dimers

clinical_correlation.title: Replication Disorders
clinical_correlation.content:
Hereditary Nonpolyposis Colorectal Cancer (HNPCC)

Defect: Mismatch repair (MLH1/MSH2 genes)

Marker: Microsatellite instability

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Why does DNA polymerase need a proofreading function?

The 3'→5' exonuclease activity corrects misincorporated bases, reducing error rate from ~10-4 to ~10-6 per base pair.
